assumptions: Daily floor(docks/2) reset included as bike-handling demand
Net all departures and arrivals within each local hour before inventory correction
Bike supply and collection each count one handling action; a pickup plus delivery is two actions, not one relocation
Virtual external depot balances each station's reset and within-day actions; routing, depot stock, travel, timing and truck capacity are unmodelled
Current station municipality and docks applied retrospectively; unmatched names excluded endpoint by endpoint
Trips use naive America/New_York wall timestamps; DST repeated hours are netted together
December 2023 trips used only for January 2024 arrival boundary

pilot.boundary: Pilot excludes December 2023 arrivals; full run corrects this boundary

global_cross_archive_audit.policy: Keep each ride in earliest filename source; exclusions stored only under ignored data/cache/ride_ids

boundary_convention: All endpoints assigned by actual local date/hour across downloaded archives; Dec2023 supplies Jan2024 arrivals; post-Sep2026 endpoints excluded. Source filename partitioning is inconsistent: Dec2023-May2024 start-month, June2024-March2026 end-month, April2026 start-month, May2026-September2026 end-month. Global ride-ID dedup removes observed overlaps. March2026 starts ending April2026 may be absent from both source files (unquantified internal gap). September2026 starts ending October2026 are unavailable because October archive is not yet published (right-censoring). No missing trips are imputed.

internal_gap.description: Trips starting in March and ending in April may be absent from both official archives

right_censoring.description: September departures returning in October are unavailable until October archive publication
